# Backend requirements and error troubleshooting (2025-08-21 07:27Z)

_**User (2025-08-18 18:35Z)**_

@https://context7.com/appwrite/sdk-for-node/llms.txt 
- Backend requirements (tables/collections and endpoints)
  - Auth/JWT
    - Expect Authorization: Bearer access_token on every call.
    - Endpoints used:
      - POST `/api/auth/login`, POST `/api/auth/refresh`, POST `/api/auth/logout`, GET `/api/auth/oauth/me`
  - Profiles
    - Endpoint: GET `/api/profiles/me` → returns user profile
    - Endpoint: PATCH `/api/profiles/me` body: `{ full_name?: string, phone?: string, address?: string, ... }`
    - Table: `profiles`
      - id (PK, user_id), email, full_name, phone, address, role, created_at, updated_at
    - 500 you see here likely due to missing mapping or DB write permissions; ensure body validation matches schema
  - Orders
    - Endpoint: GET `/api/orders?mine=true` → returns array of orders for `req.user.id`
    - Endpoint: POST `/api/orders`
      - body:
        - required: `title: string, description: string, price: number`
        - optional: `comments?: string, total_pages?: number, total_sections?: number, siteType?: string, sessionId?: string, wizardData?: object`
      - return: `{ data: Order }` or `Order` with fields: id, user_id, title, description, price, status ('pending'|'in_progress'|'completed'|'cancelled'), payment_status?, created_at, updated_at
    - Endpoint: POST `/api/orders/:orderId/design` body `{ design, options? }` only valid for real backend IDs
    - Table: `orders`
      - id, user_id (FK->users), title, description (stringified JSON OK), price (rial/toman – be consistent), status, payment_status, comments, total_pages, total_sections, created_at, updated_at
    - Your 500 at POST `/api/orders` is backend-side. Validate incoming fields, cast numbers, ensure user_id is set from JWT.
  - Invoices
    - Endpoint: GET `/api/invoices` → returns invoices for `req.user.id`
    - Endpoint: POST `/api/invoices` (admin or system) body: `{ orderId, amount, dueDate, description }`
    - Endpoint: POST `/api/invoices/:invoiceId/pay` body: `{ method: 'wallet'|'gateway', useWallet?: boolean, amount?: number }`
    - Table: `invoices`
      - id, user_id, order_id, amount, status ('pending'|'paid'|'due'|'overdue'|'cancelled'), due_date, description, created_at, updated_at
    - Your 500 at GET `/api/invoices` indicates service/repository error or missing table/index. Ensure it filters by user_id and returns list.
  - Receipts
    - Endpoint: GET `/api/receipts` → returns receipts for `req.user.id`
    - Endpoint: GET `/api/receipts/:id/download?format=pdf|html` → returns file blob
    - Table: `receipts`
      - id, user_id, invoice_id, payment_id, ref_id, amount, service, created_at
    - Your 500 at GET `/api/receipts` requires backend fix like invoices
  - Payments (ZarinPal)
    - Endpoint: POST `/api/payments/request` body: `{ amount: number (rials), description: string, orderId?: string }`
      - return: `{ success: true, data: { paymentUrl, authority } }` or `{ paymentUrl }`
      - On creating payment, backend should:
        - Create/ensure pending invoice for order if not exists
        - Store payment intent (authority)
    - Endpoint: POST `/api/payments/verify` body: `{ authority: string, orderId?: string }`
      - On success:
        - Mark invoice paid
        - Create receipt with refId
        - Update order status to 'active'/'in_progress'
      - Table(s): `payments` (id, user_id, order_id, authority, status, amount, created_at)
  - Wallet
    - Endpoint: POST `/api/wallets/me/deposit` body: `{ amount: number (rials), description?: string, callbackUrl?: string }`
      - return: `{ paymentUrl: string, orderId: string }`
      - Current error shows “Missing required parameter” earlier, now fixed for messaging; wallet deposit error likely backend validation mismatching field names or currency
    - Endpoint: POST `/api/wallets/me/deposit/verify` body: `{ authority: string, orderId?: string }`
      - Updates balance and records receipt/transaction
    - Endpoint: GET `/api/wallets/me/balance` → `{ data: { balance: number } }`
    - Endpoint: GET `/api/wallets/me/transactions?limit&offset`
    - Table: `wallets` (user_id, balance), `wallet_transactions` (id, user_id, type, status, amount, description, referenceId, referenceType, metadata, created_at)
  - Messaging (Appwrite topics via backend)
    - Endpoint: POST `/api/messaging/topics` body: `{ name: string, subscribe?: string[] }`
      - Our client now sends `{ name: "user:<id>", subscribe: ['me'] }`
      - Backend should create topic if not exists; store mapping in `messaging_topics` table if needed:
        - id, name, created_at
      - Optionally expose GET `/api/messaging/topics` and POST `/api/messaging/topics/:id/messages` body `{ message, data? }` for admin/internal triggers
  - Cron jobs
    - Scheduled:
      - Check invoices due dates, set 'due'/'overdue', send email reminders
      - Reconcile pending payments if needed
    - Email logs table optionally: `email_logs` (id, to, subject, status, created_at)

- What the frontend sends (payloads)
  - Create order (POST `/orders`):
    - Example:
      ```
      {
        "title": "وب‌سایت تجاری - example.ir",
        "description": "سفارش ساخت وب‌سایت",
        "price": 25000000,
        "comments": "دامنه: example.ir | دوره پرداخت: ماهانه | تمدید خودکار: خیر",
        "total_pages": 4,
        "total_sections": 12,
        "siteType": "business",
        "sessionId": "wizard_169... ",
        "wizardData": { ... } // nested object
      }
      ```
  - Request payment (POST `/payments/request`):
      ```
      { "amount": 25000000, "description": "پرداخت سفارش <orderId>", "orderId": "<orderId>" }
      ```
  - Pay invoice (POST `/invoices/:invoiceId/pay`):
      ```
      { "method": "wallet", "useWallet": true, "amount": 25000000 }
      ```
  - Wallet deposit (POST `/wallets/me/deposit`):
      ```
      { "amount": 34333330, "description": "شارژ کیف پول - ...", "callbackUrl": "https://arzansite.com/wallet-payment-callback" }
      ```
  - Messaging subscribe (POST `/messaging/topics`):
      ```
      { "name": "user:<userId>", "subscribe": ["me"] }
      ```

- Why your current errors happen
  - Messaging 500 “Missing required parameter: name”: the backend expects `name`; I updated the frontend to send `name`.
  - Orders 500 at POST `/api/orders`: backend validation/mapping issue (e.g., expecting integers, missing user context, collection missing). Ensure `req.user.id` is used and fields match DTO.
  - 404 saving design to `/orders/local_*`: we now skip design save for local drafts.
  - Profiles PATCH 500: backend expects schema fields; ensure DTO includes only allowed fields and DB update is correct.

### File upload: exact frontend request and backend contract
- Frontend request (bulk upload):
  - Method: POST
  - URL: /api/uploads/bulk
  - Headers: Authorization: Bearer <JWT>; DO NOT set Content-Type manually (browser sets multipart boundary)
  - Body: multipart/form-data
    - files: multiple entries of type File (name `files`)
    - fileType: string (category, e.g. general | design | logo)
    - description: string (optional)
    - orderId: string (optional, associate files to an order)
- Example (browser):
```ts
const form = new FormData();
files.forEach(f => form.append('files', f));
form.append('fileType', selectedCategory); // e.g. 'general'
if (description) form.append('description', description);
if (orderId) form.append('orderId', orderId);
await fetch(`${baseURL}/uploads/bulk`, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {},
  body: form,
  credentials: 'include',
});
```
- Backend expectations (NestJS):
  - Controller: POST /uploads/bulk
  - Guard: JWT; use @User() to read user.id
  - Interceptor: FilesInterceptor('files', maxCount) or AnyFilesInterceptor
  - Limits: fileSize (e.g. 25–50MB) and count (e.g. max 10)
  - Storage: stream temp files to Appwrite storage (createFile), keep mapping in DB with: file_id, user_id, order_id?, bucket_id, original_name, mime_type, size, created_at
  - Response shape:
    - 200: { success: true, files: [{ id: fileId, url: downloadUrl, name, size, type }] }
    - 4xx/5xx: { success: false, error }
- To fix net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR on POST /uploads/bulk:
  - Don’t set Content-Type manually on the client
  - Increase body limits (Nest/Multer): MulterModule.register({ limits: { fileSize: 50 * 1024 * 1024 } })
  - Proxy/web server: increase client_max_body_size (Nginx) and HTTP/2 frame limits if applicable
  - Ensure CORS for multipart and credentials; if you use cookies, allow credentials and set proper CORS origin

### Order and payment flow: reliable persistence and verify
- What the frontend now does:
  - On submit:
    - Tries POST /api/orders with a full payload (title, description, price, comments, total_pages, total_sections, siteType, sessionId, wizardData object)
    - If order creation fails, we store:
      - local draft (dashboard shows it) and
      - `pending_order_payload` in localStorage for callback recovery
    - Calls POST /api/payments/request with { amount (rials), description, orderId?, callbackUrl }
  - On callback (/payment/callback):
    - Reads Authority and Status from URL
    - If order_id exists -> verify with { authority, orderId }
    - If order_id missing -> creates order from `pending_order_payload`, then verify with { authority, orderId }
- Backend endpoints and tables:
  - POST /api/orders
    - Body: as above; service must set user_id from @User(); stringify wizardData before save
    - Appwrite collection “orders” must have: title (string), description (string), price (number), user_id (string), status (string), payment_status (string), comments (string), total_pages (number), total_sections (number), wizardData (string), created_at, updated_at
  - POST /api/payments/request
    - Body: { amount, description, orderId?, callbackUrl?, mobile?, email? }
    - Return: { success: true, data: { paymentUrl, authority } } or { paymentUrl, authority }
    - If orderId provided: ensure invoice exists (pending) for that order (or create it)
    - If no orderId: just create a payment intent; we’ll create the order on callback (frontend already supports this)
  - POST /api/payments/verify
    - Body: { authority: string, orderId?: string, amount?: number }
    - Verify with ZarinPal; if success:
      - Mark payment success, update (or create) invoice as paid, create receipt with refId
      - Update order.status = 'in_progress'|'active'
      - Return: { success: true, refId, orderId }
    - If failure: keep order pending with unpaid invoice so user can retry in dashboard
  - GET /api/invoices and GET /api/receipts
    - Use @User() and filter by user_id; ensure collections exist and attribute names match snake_case
- Why you saw failures:
  - POST /api/orders 500: DTO/attribute mismatch or missing attributes. Stringify wizardData and ensure numeric fields (price, total_pages, total_sections) are numbers. Ensure Appwrite has `payment_status` and `wizardData` attributes.
  - POST /api/payments/verify 400: Verify DTO should accept just { authority } and look up the pending payment by authority; orderId is optional. You already relaxed DTOs—ensure your service path doesn’t require amount/orderId.
  - Upload bulk protocol error: see the upload section above.
